entries.1e718c88163a5899: This business receives entrustment from Tokyo's 23 special wards administrative bodies to recycle non-combustible waste, container and packaging waste, and metal bulky waste at the company's recycling centers. Consolidated subsidiary Yodosei Co., Ltd. transports general waste discharged from households to government treatment facilities and disposal sites under hired-vehicle contracts with Tokyo's 23 special wards. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥3,381 million.
entries.23c299ad873abff3: Provides integrated services from collection and transport through to recycling.
entries.2d36da9ec9b5ac11: It collects, transports and disposes of industrial waste and business-related general waste from business sites, recycles brought-in resources through sorting, crushing and compression, and processes non-combustible waste and container and packaging waste entrusted by government agencies for recycling. It operates eight of its own recycling centers in the 23 wards of Tokyo and holds collection and transport permits for nearly all types of waste routinely discharged from business sites.
entries.2de27b1688732793: In addition to holding regular collection contracts with more than 8,200 discharge sites, including business sites in the 23 wards of Tokyo, it is entrusted by the government agencies of the 23 wards of Tokyo with the collection, transport and recycling of household waste, and sells the recycled resources to resource-buying companies and others.
entries.35426a39bdf4b64f: KANAME KOGYO CO.,LTD. is headquartered in Ikebukuro, Toshima-ku, Tokyo, and conducts its business together with its consolidated subsidiary, Yodosei Co., Ltd. The number of employees as of March 31, 2026 was 467.
entries.3bd5b34e47364cad: Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥14,949 million, up 3.0% from the previous year. The breakdown was ¥10,227 million from the Collection, Transport and Disposal Business, ¥3,381 million from the Government Contract Business, and ¥1,339 million from the Recycling Business.
entries.3dc630f5eff180aa: This business sorts, crushes, compresses and packs waste paper, bottles, cans, PET bottles, bulky waste and other materials brought to recycling centers, converting them into recycled resources, and sells the recycled products and valuable materials to businesses. Cardboard and some confidential documents are collected by dedicated vehicles and sold to waste paper dealers or delivered directly to paper mills. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥1,339 million.
entries.416885969271c31d: This business collects, transports and disposes mainly industrial waste and business-related general waste from business establishments, mainly in Tokyo's 23 special wards. The company holds collection and transport permits for almost all types of waste routinely discharged from business establishments, including bottles, cans, PET bottles, bulky waste, combustible waste, cardboard and waste paper, and has regular collection contracts with more than 8,200 collection sites. As of March 31, 2026, the group owned 477 vehicles and had approximately 420 drivers. Collected waste is processed at the company's eight recycling centers in Tokyo's 23 special wards and at government incineration plants, among others. Revenue for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥10,227 million.

entries.809615ace670957d: It states that its corporate philosophy, “being a company that contributes to environmental conservation and a recycling-oriented society,” is central to its business activities, and that it pursues the building of a recycling-oriented society and environmental conservation, aiming for steady growth by always approaching its work with a spirit of legal compliance. In the Collection, Transport and Disposal Business, it says that sales staff with deep knowledge of waste will provide peace of mind through thorough legal compliance and aim to steadily increase its number of customers. In the Recycling Business, it says it will pursue higher recycling rates and further resource recovery through revamping and expanding its recycling centers, improving quality through thorough sorting, and developing new resource recycling channels.

entries.8ab8402a388bda62: The annual volume of business-related general waste handled was 85,694 tons (fiscal 2024), accounting for approximately 10.2% of the amount of waste brought into the 23 wards of Tokyo in fiscal 2024. It holds permits to conduct collection and transport of business-related general waste in all 23 wards of Tokyo, and holds industrial waste permits in each prefecture and city of the Tokyo metropolitan area.
